create_Cauchy_mutation: create a Cauchy mutation layer that replaces data with standard Cauchy random values
create_Crossover_mutation: create a Crossover mutation to merge parts of one array into another along specified axes
create_Translation_mutation: create a Translation mutation that rolls array data along specified axes by random shifts
create_Jumping_mutation: create a Jumping mutation that moves a random chunk of data to another position along an axis
create_LocalGaussian_mutation: create a LocalGaussian mutation that adds Gaussian noise to a random slice of the array
